evidence: The yttrium content was determined by Rutherford backscattering spectroscopy. Film crystallinity and thickness was evaluated by grazing-incidence diffraction and X-ray reﬂection (XRR). For electrical measurements, Al /HfO2:Y/TiN/Si/Al capacitors were constructed. The capacitance–voltage curves were measured using an HP4284A precision LCR meter at 1 kHz. The CET was calculated from CET = 3.9/H92550A/C, where 3.9 is the relative permittivity of SiO 2 and /H92550 is the vacuum permittivity, A is the capacitor area /H208490.204 mm 2/H20850, and C is the capacitance measured at zero bias voltage. For current–voltage measurements a Keithley 2400 source meter was used.
